In 2065 you got talking to Signe Engel (59, spontaneous), a stranger at SoHo Park. It was about a 1-in-11,000 chance that week. You had been in the same room 91 times before without speaking.
You only ever spoke that once.
In 2035 you got talking to Kenji Reyes (46, spontaneous), a stranger at The Quiet Anchor. It was about a 1-in-15,000,000 chance that week.
You only ever spoke that once.

beats.title: San Francisco, 2026
beats.text: You're 19. At the table: your dad and your mom. Your older brother Ben has already left for Chicago.

beats.title: Growing up
beats.text: Kofi Lambert, 22, spontaneous. You have known each other as long as you can remember. You quiz each other on flags. Kofi makes some up to see if you notice. Bikes, every evening, until the streetlights come on. Kofi is at your house so often that your family stops asking and just sets a place. At 58 you will still be calling Kofi.
At 23 you leave San Francisco for New York. Kofi helps you pack and leaves with your grey hoodie. Kofi stays.

beats.title: 2029 to 2038
beats.text: You grew up seeing Kofi all the time. In the 9 years after 2029, not once. The first year you call or write 12 times. The last, once.
Ben dies, aged 39. You saw each other 6 times in that last year, and 42 times since you were 19.

beats.title: New York, 2038
beats.text: Kofi flies out for a long weekend and sleeps on your sofa. It is the first time in 9 years.

beats.title: December 2038
beats.text: Ben died in 2036. Dad and Mom are far away this year. You spend it without them.

beats.title: Kettle & Badger Café, 2040
beats.text: You stay until they stack the chairs. Kofi tells you something nobody else knows. From here on Kofi is one of the first people you tell things to.
Kofi's partner, Suki, dies. You do not know what to say, so you do the washing-up and stay.
You get together with Rafael Doyle, 42, spontaneous, from Tribeca Pub Quiz. You have known each other a year.

beats.title: December 2048
beats.text: You travel to Chicago for it. It is Rafael's first time at the table.
Your dad dies, aged 86. Kofi does your dishes without a word and stays until you fall asleep on the sofa.

beats.title: Without Kofi
beats.text: No Linh, and no Dmitri. 5 of the people in your life reached you through Kofi: someone Kofi brought along, and then the people they brought.
Your mom dies, aged 82. Kofi sits with you and lets the television run. Nobody says anything useful. It helps.

beats.title: December 2065
beats.text: You're 58. Dad's chair is empty. Mom's chair is empty. Nobody from the table you grew up at is left. It is you and Rafael.

beats.title: Axel, 58
beats.text: Kofi is still one of your closest people. You have known each other all your life, and seen each other 290 times. In 40 years you met 360 people. This was one of them.
